content.short: Flipster is a crypto exchange for trading BTC and more with deep liquidity and low fees.
content.description: Flipster is a centralized crypto exchange focused on trading, advertising deep liquidity and low fees along with ways to earn while trading. DefiLlama tracks its reserves on Stable, indicating it supports the network for deposits and withdrawals.
content.meta: Flipster is a crypto exchange with deep liquidity and low fees, supporting the Stable network.
